statement: The revision record is written before the head, and the head carries its parent. The head write is the commit point: a store's own timeout after it is a failure of what follows the write, never the publish's outcome or the caller's cancellation, and so is a change that kept moving while it was settled: either is a 503 saying the revision is written and publishing the change again settles it, never a 409 (DR1-E-7).
guards: control:CommittedRevisionTest#a store timeout indexing a written head still answers published - #1263
control:CommittedRevisionTest#a store timeout settling a published change says it is written, and a retry settles it - #1263
control:PublishedNotExpiredTest#a publish whose settling kept conflicting after the head write answers 503, written
control:CommittedRevisionTest#a caller cancelled before the head write is cancelled and writes no head - #1263
